page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-360-lssd is an x86_64 cloud server instance powered by dedicated AMD EPYC 9B14 processors. The instance provides 360 virtual CPUs across 180 physical cores with multithreading enabled, supported by 2,880 GB of system memory, yielding an 8 GB per vCPU ratio. The architecture incorporates 32 MB of L3 cache per core cluster along with hardware instruction support for AVX-512 (including VNNI and BF16) and cryptographic acceleration such as VAES and SHA-NI.

Storage consists of 12,864 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD capacity across 32 drives, eliminating network-attached storage latency for local data manipulation. No discrete hardware accelerators or GPUs are present on this configuration, focusing performance strictly on high-density central compute, immense memory footprint, and local disk throughput.

Benchmark testing demonstrates top-tier multi-threaded execution and extreme data throughput capabilities. The instance achieved top 10% bracket results in stress-ng multi-core CPU metrics (554,437.38) and PassMark CPU score (156,675.88). Uncached large-block memory bandwidth reaches 701.26 GB/sec for reads and 354.62 GB/sec for writes. Database operations and in-memory caches scale effectively, as evidenced by Redis SET operations clocking over 393 million operations per second and top-tier database operations testing in PassMark.

While single-threaded execution and sequential compression tasks place within normal strong percentiles, the system offers substantial density efficiency for large distributed systems. Workloads best matching this profile include large-scale in-memory databases, real-time analytics engines, distributed caching nodes, high-throughput static web serving, and memory-intensive ETL pipelines that fully utilize extensive local NVMe scratch space.
description: Google Cloud Platform c3d-highmem-360-lssd is a high-memory compute instance designed for intensive data processing and in-memory architectures. Built on AMD EPYC 9B14 architecture, it delivers 360 dedicated vCPUs (180 physical cores) running on x86_64 instruction sets with AVX-512 support. The server provides 2,880 GB of system RAM alongside 12,864 GB of local NVMe SSD storage distributed over 32 disks, omitting discrete GPUs. Benchmarks position the instance in the top tier for multi-core compute, uncached memory bandwidth exceeding 700 GB/sec read, and in-memory key-value throughput reaching 393 million Redis operations per second. The balanced high-memory ratio and extensive local disk array provide strong density and throughput efficiency without network storage bottlenecks. This configuration fits high-scale database clusters, massive in-memory analytics, real-time caching layers, and high-core compilation and ETL workloads.
